author: Kalmathar
quote: Even if we ignore the myriad of bugs in the game, which hopefully could be fixed in the future, I really can't give this game a good score. The game totally breaks the concept of all the GTA Series, takes the fun parts out, lets a lot of chores and boredom in, and is an example of what happens when you try to push an agenda instead of trying to make a good game and keep your customers happy. Maybe due to the hype and because the game has been so much expected by many it will have good sales (but somewhat forced due to the refusal of reimbursements), but it has hammered the last nail in the coffin of the franchise. Better get back to playing GTA V.
